classes.summary: This is an Android UI page class for printer management functionality in a mobile automation framework. It inherits from SmartFlow base class and implements the Page Object Model pattern. Key patterns include: (1) Exception handling with fallback mechanisms (NoSuchElementException caught to try alternative locators), (2) Conditional permission handling based on boolean flags, (3) Flow-based navigation with documented end states, (4) Selenium WebDriver integration for mobile element interactions, (5) Locator constants defined as class variables for maintainability. The class handles printer discovery, WiFi Direct permissions, and location permissions typical in Android mobile testing scenarios.
